analyst.summary: Gillette India is a debt-free, highly capital-efficient FMCG franchise (Gillette razors, Oral-B, Braun) growing revenue at a high-single-digit to low-double-digit pace, most recently 11% in the June 2026 quarter. The business is mature and non-cyclical with no red flags, but its valuation (~39x earnings) already reflects that quality and consistency -- there isn't much room for the stock to re-rate further from here. A steady, low-drama holding rather than one with a fresh reason to add or trim.
